hypothesis_change_reason: Dispatch 133 asserted, as its central factual premise, that no controller or postrun caller ever sets AC_CORE_ROOT, and routed the fix to a one-line controller change. Direct reading of the callers falsifies that premise. This dispatch also proved, by executing W57's own closeout validator, that the core-digest red never appears in W57's closeout verdict at all, which re-routes the whole 124-133 chain off a mis-owned target.

narrative.FINDING: The canonical-core-revision-changed red that dispatches 124-133 chased is a PROGRAM-level POSTRUN item and is not part of W57's closeout gate. W57's own gate is the absent artifacts/wave_W57/WAVE_W57_EVIDENCE_MANIFEST.json, whose only admissible cause is unsatisfied FREEZE-030/-040.
narrative.OBSERVED_FAILURE: python scripts/validate_wave_closeout.py --wave W57 -> can_close=false with EXACTLY ONE failure_reason: missing/invalid evidence manifest. There is no core-digest, materialization or AC_CORE_ROOT term in the verdict. Separately, python .opencode/scripts/validate-ac-project.py -> FAIL with canonical-core-revision-changed + 30 managed-file-content-mismatch; that script is listed in the profile under postrun_checks, not as a per-Wave gate.
narrative.HYPOTHESIS: If the core-digest red gated W57, validate_wave_closeout.py --wave W57 would name it. It does not. Therefore W57 has been re-entered thirteen times against a target that cannot change W57's outcome, and the true W57 gate must be identified before any further repair attempt is meaningful.
narrative.CHANGE: Measurement only. Read-only: validate_wave_closeout.py, materialization_guard.py --check (never --write), validate-ac-project.py, lab/lab-status.ps1, pytest, Select-String over .opencode/scripts/*.ps1, and git read commands (rev-parse, status, cat-file, archive) on this project and on the Agent Core. narrative.RESULT: Hypothesis confirmed. Three prior claims are falsified by execution and the routing is corrected. W57's own surface is green; its gate is blocked only by FREEZE-030/-040, whose blockers are all owned outside W57, one of which requires genuinely unavailable Hyper-V administrator authority.

claim_1_no_caller_ever_sets_the_knob.falsified_by: The caller audit omitted every .ps1 file. Select-String over .opencode/scripts/*.ps1 shows the controller DOES resolve and set the variable, twice:
claim_1_no_caller_ever_sets_the_knob.evidence_1: .opencode/scripts/start-wave-program.ps1:174-185 defines Get-ACCoreRoot, which returns $env:AC_CORE_ROOT when it is a container, else falls back to the sibling .agents-core. Line 187-188: '$CoreRoot=Get-ACCoreRoot' then 'if($CoreRoot){ $env:AC_CORE_ROOT=$CoreRoot }'. This is the program entry point.
claim_1_no_caller_ever_sets_the_knob.evidence_2: .opencode/scripts/run-ac-wave-opencode-phase.ps1:202-212 performs the identical Get-ACCoreRoot-then-assign sequence for the opencode phase runner, and run-ac-wave-hybrid-phase.ps1:203-213 and run-ac-wave-luna-openai-phase.ps1:203-213 do the same.
claim_1_no_caller_ever_sets_the_knob.consequence: The one-line remedy dispatch 133 routed to the controller ('pin AC_CORE_ROOT to a committed core ref in POSTRUN') is ALREADY IMPLEMENTED. No controller code change is required or justified. The pin is honored end-to-end from the launch environment, and both the controller and validate-ac-project.py:115-117 implement the SAME unset-to-live-sibling fallback, so there is no asymmetry to repair.

claim_2_the_pin_numbers_prove_the_projec.prior_text: 91 mismatches @v1.0.0, 92 @origin/main, 99 @origin/fix, 30 @LIVE, therefore 'the project was materialized from core bytes NEWER than every attested ref'.
claim_2_the_pin_numbers_prove_the_projec.falsified_by: The 91 was an artifact of extraction, not a property of the commit. The Agent Core repo has core.autocrlf=true and no .gitattributes, so 'git archive' converts LF blobs to CRLF and can never be byte-equal to the committed bytes.
claim_2_the_pin_numbers_prove_the_projec.measurement: Byte-faithful extraction via 'git -c core.autocrlf=false -c core.eol=lf archive' of v1.0.0 (73c1b7d) gives 50 mismatches of 110 managed targets, not 91. Directly comparing the 30 project files that differ from the live core against the committed v1.0.0 blob: 21 are BYTE-IDENTICAL to v1.0.0, 0 match the core working tree, 9 match neither.
claim_2_the_pin_numbers_prove_the_projec.consequence: The stated inference does not follow. Twenty-one of the thirty differ-from-live files are exactly the v1.0.0 blobs, so the project is not 'newer than every attested ref'. The pin was measured with a broken instrument.
